tei:div.tei:p: 403) snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus cha lag -i thi: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i rgya can shin tu zab pa bzhugs: 404) na mo dz+nyā na ḍā ki ye: (Dakini secret letter here)

dbyings spyod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud: stong dbyings shes rab rdo rje btsun mo yi: sgrub thabs zab mo 'od gsal sgron ma ni: bsam gyis mi khyab kun gyi snying po mchog: tshe 'dir sgyu lus ma spangs 'od gsal dbyings: mkha' spyod mngon par grol ba'i gdams pa mchog: skal ldan las can bu yi don du bkod: gcig brgyud ma gtogs yongs la spel mi bya: spel na mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi chad pa 'byung: sa ma ya: de la mkha' 'gro sgrub pa la: bhan thod mtshan ldan shel rdo dang: me long bum pa sku tsaka sogs: mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma sgrub rdzas rnams: legs par bkod nas bsgrub par bya: rab ni rnal 'byor spyod dang bstun: dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas su bsgrub: sa ma ya: 405) dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro la: skyabs sems bya ba 'di skad do: na mo: gzhi dbyings sku gsum stong pa'i dbyings: ye shes mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchi: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sems can kun: rang ngo shes par sems bskyed do: lan gsum bya: yan lag bdun pa ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs la: ma bcos gnyug mar phyag 'tshal lo: dngos yid dag pa'i mchod pa 'bul: gzung 'dzin sgrib pa dbyings su bshags: rang gzhan dge la rjes yi rangs: zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: gzhon nu bum skur bzhugs gsol 'debs: 406)'khor gsum dmigs bral chen por bsngo: rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: bka' bsgo ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: log 'dren ru tra 'dul ba'i gshed: gnyis 'dzin gdon bgegs thams cad kun: yul med zang thal chen por dengs: hūm̐ ham̐'u u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ham̐'u bzhi dang drag sngags kyis bskrad: srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: rang byung bde ba chen po'i dbyings: ye shes gdangs lnga'i gur khang 'khrigs: kun brtags mtshan mas glags mi rnyed: srung ba'i 'khor lo rab tu brtan:

badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: dam bzung ni: hūm̐: rang rig gdod nas sangs rgyas te: don gyi phag mo'i rang zhal mjal: srog gi phyir du mi 'da' bar: ye nas 'gyur med dam bca' 'o: badz+ra tsit+ta a: byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min khyab brdal chen po'i zhing: dhu ma tha la'i gnas mchog nas: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rje mo mchog: rdo rje phag mo rgyal ba'i yum: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: sgrub mchog sgo gsum smin par mdzod: sku gsum mngon du gyur pa dang: 407)mchog thun dngos grub byin phob cig: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya ā we sha ya a āḥ mchod pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐: snang ba'i yul kun dag pa che: phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab: kun bzang sprin gyi cho 'phrul du: rab 'byams zhing kun khyab par gyur: ma hā sarba pū dza hoḥ bshags pa ni: hūm̐: rang rig lha dang dbyer med par: ma rtog gnyis snang 'khrul pas bsgribs: gnyis med ye shes chen po'i ngang: dag chen chos dbyings klong du bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ dngos gzhi lha yi ting 'dzin ni: āḥ rnam thar gsum ldan stong pa nyid: gdangs snang ma 'gags snying rje'i rtsal: rgyu yi yi ge bam̐ dmar po: 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: rang rig bam̐ dmar yongs gyur las: rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig spyan gsum dbyings su bgrad: phyag g.yas gri gug mkha' la phyar: gnyis snang rtog pa zil 408)gyis gnon: g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin: dpa' bo dgyes bskang dngos grub bskul: dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'khyil: phag zhal nag pos ngur sgra sgrog: thod skam lnga yi rtse bran mdzes: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang: gzig gi pags pa'i smad sham dkris: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs shing:

pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: sku la khro mo'i chas rnams rdzogs: dpa' bo yab tshul kha ṭ+waṃ ka: g.yon gyi phyogs su sbas tshul 'chang: gnas lngar mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dal: rtsa gnas rlung dang thig le'i khams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: dam tshig lha yi gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min gnas kyi mchog: gsang chen rol pa'i zhing khams nas: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: rdo rje phag mo 'khor dang bcas: spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab gling dbus mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i gnas mchog nas: rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo'i 409)lha tshogs dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren thugs rjes gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du smin par mdzod: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral gzhi klong nas: lhun grub rol gar dkyil 'khor lha: gnyis med mnyam pa chen po'i ngang: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir brtan bzhugs gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni: na mo: bde gshegs gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rje mo mchog: rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum dag pas phyag bgyi'o: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i klong: ye shes sgyu 'phrul chen por shar: 'dod yon ma spangs phyi mchod dang: nyon mongs gnas dag nang gi mchod: bde stong gnyis med gsang mchod rnams: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha la 'bul: 410)bzhes nas snang bar dbang thob nas: mchog thun dngos grub dam pa stsol: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ

sogs: shap+da rū pa sogs: dharma sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sarba pū dza khā hiḥ bstod pa ni: hrīḥ ye nas chos nyid brjod pa bral ba'i ngang: thugs rje'i rtsal snang ma 'gags cho 'phrul ngoms : ye shes gar bsgyur dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab tu dad pa chen pos phyag 'tshal bstod: hoḥ rgyal yum ye shes mkha' 'gro dgongs: bdag cag gnyis 'dzin 'khrul dbang gis: sgo gsum bag med ci bsags bshags: dag tshangs dngos grub stsal du gsol: yig brgya brjod: 'dzab ni: hrīḥ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka ru: bam̐ dmar mtha' mar sngags g.yon 'khor: 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal kun gyi: gsang gsum yon tan ma lus bstim: 'od zer mar 'phros 'gro kun gyi: las sgrib bag chags byang nas kyang: thams cad bde la 'god par bsam: slar yang srid zhi'i tshe bsod nams: gzi brjid dpal 'byor yon tan rnams: 'od zer rnam par rang la bstim: snang grags lha sngags ting nge 411)'dzin: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol pa ru: rig stong chos nyid chen por shar: dag pa rab 'byams ngang nas bzlas: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi bam̐ ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: ces pa ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang: sgra dag mi tshig ma 'dres par: 'bum tsho bcu yis 'grub par nges: rab dngos 'bring nyams rmi lam sogs: ut+pal dmar po'i tshal dang ni: mi ro bza' dang thod phreng rnyed: de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma gsal: mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags yin no: sa ma ya: rjes rim tshogs mchod bya ba la: bza' bca' la sogs 'dod yon tshogs: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod rdzas bsags: ting nge 'dzin gyis spel bar bya: de nas byin rlabs bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'khor 'das dag mnyam chen po'i klong: snang ba yangs pa'i bhan+dha ru: srid pa 'dod yon phun sum tshogs: thabs shes rdzas mchog bla na med: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum dang:

nam mkha' mdzod kyi byin gyis brlab: spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rnam dag bde chen dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: rig stong bde chen mchog gi rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs su 412)gsol: gnas gsum dag pa rdo rje'i pho brang nas: 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs su gsol: 'dod yon mchod tshogs ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: rnal 'byor pho mo'i sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bdud rtsi 'bul ba niḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor: nyon mongs ma spangs bdud rtsi che: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: tshogs phud ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'dod yon ma spangs tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bde stong gnyis med ngang du bzhes nas kyangaḥ rig stong ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hiḥ bshags pa ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul dbang gis: sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba gang: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sa ma ya sogs nas: 413)āḥ bsgral bstab ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ kun brtags gzung 'dzin ru tra rnams: bdag med ye shes klong du bsgral: ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags lus: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstab: sarba sha truṃ ru tra mā ra ya pū dza hoḥ drang pa ni: hoḥ bla med gsang ba chen po'i rdzas: thabs shes longs spyod mchod pa che: rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer du: gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha la 'bul: a la la ho dngos grub stsol: lhag ma ni:

pheṃ bh+yo: sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka'i: bka' nyan las byed pho nya'i tshogs: lhag gtor bshal chu 'di bzhes la: gang bcol las rnams 'grub par mdzod: oṃ sarba uts+tshiṣa ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dbyings snang chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs nas: rig stong dbyer med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha: gnas 'dir skur bzhengs rnal 'byor grogs mdzod la: bstan 'dzin tshe srings bstan dgra zlog cing sgrol: gsang sngags bstan pa mi nub yun brtan shog: chad tho ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus: sku gsum ston pa'i spyan snga ru: bka' 414)yi srung ma dam can rnams: dmar chen gter ma skyems phud bzhes: phrin las rab 'byams 'grub par mdzod: brtan skyong ni: hūm̐: rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: las bzhi'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bro mnan ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag nyid rngams brjid khros pa'i sku: ma rig gnyis snang dam sri kun: 'od gsal chen pos bro brdungs shing: mtha' bral gnyis med klong du mnan: oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ sarba shā truṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: dngos grub bskul ba ni: hoḥ skye med ka dag dbyings klong nas: bde stong ye shes bskyed pa'i ma: rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo yi: gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor nas: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs: thun mong grub pa brgyad dang ni: mchog tu rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i: dngos grub brnyes shing don gnyis 'grub: zung 'jug ye shes sku thob shog: rtsa sngags dang: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying bya: bsngo ba ni: hoḥ zag bcas zag med dge tshogs ci bsags kun: ma gyur 415) 'gro ba sems can yongs la bsngo: kun kyang srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol nas kyang: kun bzang rdzogs pa chen po'i don rtogs shog:

smon lam ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin bgyis pa'i mthus: bdag cag sgrub pa'i mched lcam rnams: mi 'bral tshom bu gcig la ni: 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams su: bde chen dpal la spyod par shog: gshegs bsdu ni: hoḥ ye shes sems dpa' 'od gsal dbyings su gshegs: dam tshig pa nyid dmigs med chen por gyur: ye shes sgyu ma'i ngang du go bgo'o: skad cig chu zla'i tshul gyis spyod lam bya'o: bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral chos sku'i bkra shis shog: rang bzhin lhun grub longs sku'i bkra shis shog: thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku'i bkra shis shog: sku gsum mngon du gyur pa'i bkra shis shog: gzhan yang bkrashis ci rigs brjod: sa ma ya: e ma: shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug chos: gsang ba bla na med pa yi: rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag: bde stong rdo rje phag mo yi: sgrub thabs rdo rje'i rgya can 'di: skal ldan don du yi ger bkod: ma 'ongs nyi shu kha ral dus: su kha 416) badz+ra dang 'phrad tshe: chos kyi bdag po nyi ma dang: gsang grogs bid+ya badz+ra sogs: phrad nas 'gro don rim bzhin 'byung: gcig brgyud ma gtogs spel mi rung: 'brel tshad 'og min gnas du bgrod: the tshom med do gu h+ya rgya: zhes pa ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs 'di yang dngos slob dam pa dpal ldan rgya mtsho dang skyes bu dam pa snyan grags sogs kyis bskul ngor/ rdzun rkyal skyon kun ldan pa dhe wa'i ming gis 'khrul snang la bsdebs nas bris pa'o// ༈ phag mo'i gzhal yas khang bskyed ba'i bam̐ yig gi don nga rang gis mi shes kyang: 'khrul snang 'kha' 'gro ma zhig gis 'id ltar zer: chos can thams cad chos nyid gcig gi ngang: rgyal ba'i dgongs pa tshad bzung yul las 'das: 'khor 'das gnyis med ye shes klong du gcig: ma rgyud gsang ba snying po'i dgongs pa'oḥ
sa ma ya: zhes zer ra:
